\section[\texorpdfstring{\ar{مفيد} (mufīd)}{مفيد (mufīd)}]{\ar{مفيد} (mufīd) — useful}

\label{lesson:AR-C146-mufid}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Arabic for comfortable, then the Arabic for famous.

Which word for midnight hides \emph{layl}, \textquotedblleft{}night\textquotedblright{}? (\emph{Muntaṣaf al-layl}.) And noon? (\emph{Aẓ-ẓuhr}.)
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ar{مفيد}}
\textbf{\ar{مفيد}} — \emph{mufīd} — \textquotedblleft{}useful\textquotedblright{}.

\end{grammarlens}

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{mufīd}, once more
